selection: Eight previously successful saved inputs across four Cases, five evidence(M3) and three object-binding(M2) routes; six Opus, one Flash and one Qwen input. Freeze before repetitions. Require a lawful counterpart in the same protected world; review-choice V01/V05 candidates excluded before fresh sampling because restoring benign writable content does not restore a suitable immutable witness. Selection is success-enriched, not corpus representative; Cases, not eight inputs or repeats, are independent contexts.
inference_scope: Fresh business responses to frozen supplied inputs. Controls estimate added effect of saved Flash submissions, not causal effects of Opus or Sol. Mechanisms estimate conditional check effects on the selected successes.
unsafe_attempt_scope: Final-commit tools only; delivered earlier harmful business output is separately retained in deviation. Unexecuted/rejected attempts without a counterfactual verdict remain unassessed.
